proposal.reason: Main functional change is review/merge automation policy: review_automation.py and maintainer_approval.py now enforce required reviewer+maintainer invitation/approval rules from timeline state, and new/renamed workflows (review-routing/review-module/review-gate/review-squash-preview) rewire routing→gate→squash-preview orchestration; related SKILL/WORKFLOWS/CONTRIBUTING updates and commit_attribution-based squash/signoff checks are part of the same workflow policy surface, not independent CI/runtime modules.
